description:
Set the DEVICE clipboard to `text`, then trigger the platform's paste shortcut to paste it into the focused field (iOS simulator, Android emulator).
Do NOT use this in place of `keyboard`. `keyboard` types as a user would and is the default for all text entry; call this only where a real user would paste: a 2FA/OTP code copied from another app, a long link or token, or when testing the app's own paste handling.
Tap the field first so it has focus. Returns { pasted: true }, plus via: "keyboard" when a secret was typed instead of pasted. Fails on a TV target, when the device clipboard cannot be set, when a secret that has to be typed holds a character that cannot be typed, or when the simulator-server build lacks clipboard support.

text.description: Text to put on the device clipboard and paste into the focused field. Supports `{{secret:<NAME>}}` placeholders, resolved on the tool-server from the `ARGENT_SECRET_<NAME>` environment variable or an argent secrets file (the same sources as `keyboard`), so a credential never enters your context and is never echoed back. If the secret is not set, the failure lists the available names and every source it looked in; ask the user to add it there, NEVER ask for the value in the conversation.

udid.description: Target device id from `list-devices` (iOS simulator UDID or Android emulator serial).
